title: VN Sprite Set
description: Character cutouts for the VN stage. Portraits, backgrounds and CGs are separate asset roles.

types.description: Card-specific stable IDs and labels. Normal is protected. New cards seed Uniform, Casual, Controlled_Battle, Battle_Holder and Battle_Cascade; existing catalogs retain their options.

emotions.description: Card-specific stable IDs and labels. Built-ins are protected. Warn at 20 emotions.

spriteTypes.description: Wardrobe ID to character inventory; sprites holds Normal. Types have no arbitrary count cap. Each character may have different expressions or no artwork.

spriteVariants.description: Optional stable variant IDs and display labels within each wardrobe type. Base outfits remain in sprites or spriteTypes.

spriteVariantSprites.description: Type to variant to character inventory. Missing expressions fall back only within the selected type and variant; missing art never borrows another costume.

spriteVariantWardrobeDescriptions.description: Character display name to type to variant to clothing description, independent of image availability.

spriteChapterDefaults.description: Stable chapter-opening greeting ID to character name to starting type and optional variant. Later explicit wardrobe changes persist on the accepted story branch.

spriteWardrobeDescriptions.description: Character display name to wardrobe ID to authored clothing description. Descriptions are separate from identity and image assignments.

npcSprites.description: Optional authored cutout pools for undefined NPCs. Gender comes from explicit story metadata, not name or pronoun guessing. The visible speaker label remains NPC.

sprites.description: A reusable inventory keyed by stable character ID. Display limits apply to the stage, not this inventory.

npcPool.description: Image IDs map to transparent authored cutouts. A stable NPC ID and session seed select one image; the ID is never displayed as NPC A/B/C.

speakerName.description: Exact character display name used by [SPEAKER:name:emotion:type:variant] or [Name:name:emotion:type:variant]. Omitted type retains the current outfit; explicit type without variant selects its base.

expressions.description: Only available emotion IDs map to authored cutouts. normal, or the first image in this exact outfit, is the fallback. Artwork and additional expressions are optional; prose emotions remain unrestricted.

assetRef.description: An uploaded character-cutout asset; never a portrait or CG reference by default.

mimeType.description: Declared file type. JPEG is excluded because it cannot store transparency.

transparentBackground.description: A required asset declaration. Actual transparency must also be checked in the image bytes; JSON cannot prove it.

framing.description: The authored cutout's framing. half-body means waist-up and is the suggested default for dialogue scenes; bust means chest-up. full-body is an explicit artistic choice, never mandatory. Sprites occupy the scene behind the dialogue layer rather than shrinking to fit above it. This field does not instruct the engine to crop a portrait or CG.

anchor.description: Normalized placement anchor within the source canvas; default is bottom center.
